claim_boundary: External published dispositions (TESS FOP Working Group) on targets that appear in no prior gate and live in the blind partition of the frozen split. Labels are catalogue dispositions, not re-adjudicated by this repository. Detection rates measured here transfer to this label domain and cadence regime only; they are not a survey-wide performance claim and the corpus was never used to fit or tune anything.

exclusions.policy: every id touched by a prior gate is removed before ranking, so the holdout cannot inherit a selection advantage from earlier measurements
